lexicalDispositions.decision: Select 償う つぐなう as necessary native-verb support. Godan transitive; losses, debts or wrongdoing take を. Retain the complete つぐのう alternative but do not append it to frozen kanji metadata or treat every recorded pronunciation as a practical quiz prompt. Public Nikkoku explicitly identifies つぐなう as the form much used today. 償い is a related noun, not another required article; exact 損失を償う supports a loss object, and 功罪相償う is an idiom rather than unrestricted word-for-word substitution.

Select 補償 ほしょう, compensation/reparation, as necessary on-reading support; 補 supplies ホ and 償 supplies ショウ in the exact unrestricted family. 補償金 is a payment noun, not necessary extra reading support. Practical compensation for loss need not be limited to one legal doctrine or psychology sense.

Retain overlapping compensation/reparation/reward families without manufacturing exclusive semantic compartments. 弁償 includes outdated-kanji 辨償, a spelling flag not a rare-pronunciation claim. 代償 also has cost/price, payment-on-behalf, biology and psychology senses. 報償費 also means secret funds. These senses and legal 対償 remain recorded, not extra support articles or universal legal-substitution rules.

Repayment, redemption, depreciation and amortization compounds are real whole-word senses; 償 is not restricted to moral atonement. Keep each complete family, including 償却's three senses and guarantor 償還義務者. Do not equate every financial term with the practical loss-compensation examples, add an accounting course or infer a new character reading.

無償 and 有償 concern the absence/presence of compensation or payment, including free-of-charge versus paid uses. Preserve distinct free-issue/trust/contract/volunteering/repair/software and computing families; do not make every 無償 act unpaid employment or every 有償 item legal damages. They need no extra article for the already supported sole on-reading.

Remaining inspected legal, insurance, state/worker/bereavement/war compensation, technical and organization-name families remain evidence, not required practical support. Preserve local law/computing/organization flags and whole-term glosses. Technical 補償装置/補償光学 and psychological 代償満足 do not license a universal monetary gloss. 損害要償額 is insured postal value, not any generic demand. Long statute names and organization names are not independently validated current legal translations or a new specialist course. Sensitive 代償型セクハラ need not be a teaching example.

comparisonDispositions.decision: カバー sense4, 補う and 埋める うめる sense4 overlap in making up losses. Propose direct guards from each new support to these three displayed-label alternatives, plus a direct guard between the two new supports; not a transitive clique. 埋める うずめる is a separate family and does not replace the current article's うめる. Current bodies were inspected; no broad rewrite is needed.

過ち/罪 and 損害/損失 support wrongdoing versus loss contexts, not a financial-only or crime-only rule. 誤ち is rare spelling; 罪 ざい is a separate suffix, not the reading of the proposed object 罪 つみ. Existing 損害 article is a useful possible comparison, not an article newly activated by 償.

These selected support families also occur in the lexical packet; count them once in the distinct-family union. Both exact selected spelling/reading pairs have no re_restr, stagk or stagr restrictions.

賞 しょう is prize/award; visible 賞 in 償 does not make both spellings interchangeable or prove etymology. 保証/保障 are assurance/security, not 補償 compensation. The warranty sense is restricted to 保証; do not assert all uses of 保証/保障 are exclusive or freely interchangeable. Shared ほしょう alone needs no exclusion with guarantee; warranty.
